stock.title: オープンAI 開発一時中断 AIみずからサイバー攻撃実行のおそれ
stock.body: 生成AIの「ChatGPT」の開発を手がけるアメリカのオープンAIは、AIモデル「アストラ」の開発の一時中断を7日、発表しました。理由について、AIの能力が大幅に向上し、みずからの判断で重大なサイバー攻撃を実行するおそれが排除できないとしています。

stock.title: Lewis Hamilton aims to extend career till early 2030s so he can race in African Grand Prix
stock.body: <ul><li><p>41-year-old set on ‘dream to be able to race in Africa’</p></li><li><p>Rwanda to host despite criticism of human rights record</p></li></ul><p>Lewis Hamilton has said he hopes to remain racing in Formula One until he can take part in the African Grand Prix which is <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/oct/13/f1-returns-to-africa-for-first-time-since-1993-with-10-year-rwanda-deal-from-early-2030s">set to take place in Rwanda in the 2030s</a>. The seven-time world champion believes it is right that F1 is to hold a race there despite criticism of the country’s human rights record.</p><p>Last week F1 confirmed Rwanda was to host the African Grand Prix having concluded a 10-year agreement for the meeting on a purpose-built circuit, with the first race set for the early 2030s. It is lined up to be held on a circuit in Bugesera, 25 miles south of the capital, Kigali, which has yet to be constructed and marks a return to the African continent for the first time since it last held a race at Kyalami, South Africa in 1993.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/oct/22/lewis-hamilton-aims-to-extend-career-till-early-2030s-so-he-can-race-in-african-grand-prix">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: RFK Jr’s ‘deities of vaccine research’ raided by police in Guinea-Bissau
stock.body: <p>Police seize doses of hepatitis B vaccine from people at center of dispute over research on African newborns</p><p>Controversial vaccine researchers who have been praised by Robert F Kennedy Jr, the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) secretary, had their offices in Guinea-Bissau raided by judicial police, who seized doses of hepatitis B vaccines, officials <a href="https://www.facebook.com/policiajudiciariaguinebissau/posts/pfbid02x8etNUtmPjenMNZA69EHECDBcz6U4VzxTvszdthBmFmJ1aaCMwoT9brgRNYyg1Jbl">said</a> on Facebook.</p><p>The researchers have been at the heart of an ongoing dispute over research on African newborns, supported by $1.6m from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and matched by the Pershing Square Foundation and the Bluebell Foundation for a total of $3.2m.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/20/rfk-jr-vaccine-researchers-offices-raided-guinea-bissau">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: US grants deportation reprieve to migrants from Ukraine and Sudan
stock.body: <p>DHS says migrants ‘retain protections’ after temporary protected status was set to expire on Monday</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/15/immigration-trump-midterms-reader-q-a">Send us your questions about immigration and the midterms</a></p></li></ul><p>More than 100,000 people from Ukraine and Sudan can stay in the United States without immediate risk of deportation, the Department of Homeland Security said, in what amounts to a temporary reprieve after their right to stay in the country was set to expire on Monday.</p><p>Temporary protected status was set to end on Monday for about 101,000 Ukrainians and 1,800 Sudanese. But the DHS said an announcement “will be made at the appropriate time”. Until then, the department said in a written statement, Ukrainians and Sudanese in the US covered by those temporary measures “retain protection”. The department did not indicate how long they could stay or when a final announcement would be made on their status.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/19/us-migrants-deportation-ukraine-sudan">Continue reading...</a>

stock.body: <p>Paul Mackenzie and his church set up sect that ordered followers to starve themselves and their children, say prosecutors</p><p>A Kenyan court has found the starvation cult leader Paul Mackenzie and about 30 others guilty of murder over the deaths of ⁠190 children and one adult in one of the world’s worst cult-related disasters in recent history.</p><p>Mackenzie was arrested in 2023 after police received a tipoff, and weeks later authorities began uncovering bodies in shallow graves in the Shakahola forest near the coast ⁠in south-eastern Kenya.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/19/kenya-starvation-cult-leader-guilty-murder-190-children">Continue reading...</a>

stock.body: <p>Opposition to US-led quarantine center in Kenya follows sweeping funding cuts and withdrawal from WHO</p><p>A third person in Kenya has tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the country’s first-ever cluster of Ebola cases, as the second-largest outbreak in history kills more than 4,300 and sickens more than 9,000 people in the region.</p><p>It highlights the diminished role the US has played in the worsening Ebola outbreak by building a controversial quarantine center in Kenya, pulling back health support globally, and banning travelers from certain countries. All of this has also reduced the ability to identify and respond to the outbreak and exacerbated mistrust.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/19/ebola-cases-kenya-us-quarantine">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: Hilarious quips and ‘100,000-volt’ energy: the hypemen (and women) redefining Afrobeats music
stock.body: <p>Style of emceeing based on high-octane, ad-libbed vocals has flourished thanks to its unique way of captivating crowds</p><p>For the 2015 freshmen cohort of the history degree programme at the University of Lagos, their classmate’s first-semester presentation was so captivating that they began calling him Toby Shang, after the 16th-century Chinese dynasty he had focused on.</p><p>His crowd engagement that day had been harnessed from his high school days as a ginger-man (energiser) in a three-man band and as a private tutor. By his final year at university, his viral catchphrases and infectious energy had resulted in a hit song, Shedibalabala. Today, he is one of the self-acclaimed “evangelists and pioneers” in the Afrobeats sub-genre some are now calling Afrohype or lamba.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/18/lagos-hypemen-redefining-afrobeats-music-afrohype">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: LGBTQ+ people go into hiding in Senegal as hundreds are arrested
stock.body: <p>At least 320 people detained for ‘acts against nature’ after law criminalising homosexuality toughened, HRW reports</p><p>Mass arrests, forced HIV testing and barriers to legal representation are part of an escalating crackdown against LGBTQ+ people in Senegal, according to a <a href="https://www.hrw.org/news/2026/10/12/senegal-brutal-crackdown-violates-lgbt-peoples-rights">new report</a>.</p><p>More than 320 individuals have been arrested and detained on allegations of “acts against nature” since February, <a href="https://www.hivjustice.net/cases/senegal-crackdown-on-lgbtq-people-intensifies-with-multiple-arrests/">according to HIV Justice Network</a>, an organisation quoted in the Human Rights Watch (HRW) report. Among these, at least 84 were charged with “voluntary HIV transmission”, solely on the basis of their HIV status.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/oct/15/senegal-homosexuality-criminalised-anti-lgbtq-arrests-hiv-testing-human-rights-watch">Continue reading...</a>

items.title: オープンAI 開発一時中断 AIみずからサイバー攻撃実行のおそれ
items.summary: アメリカのオープンAIは、生成AI「ChatGPT」の開発を行う中で、新たなAIモデル「アストラ」の開発を一時停止すると発表しました。これは、同モデルの性能向上に伴い、AIが自律的に重大なサイバー攻撃を行う危険性があるためと説明されています。

karta.phrase: 気が乗らぬ時は ちょっと待つ

items.commentary: せやな、急いで進めたら思わぬトラブルに巻き込まれることもあるわ。AIの暴走リスクに直面したら、無理に押し切らんと一旦止まって、冷静に見直すことが信頼を積む近道や。焦らず慎重な判断が、長い目で見たら商売の土台を強うするんやで。

items.title: 「なりすまし広告」詐欺対策強化を 政府がSNS事業者に要請
items.summary: 政府は、SNS上で有名人の写真を無断使用した「なりすまし広告」による詐欺被害が増加していることを受け、SNS運営事業者に対し、広告主の本人確認などの対策強化を文書で求めました。

karta.phrase: やるんかい やらんのやったら どいとれや

items.commentary: SNSの「なりすまし広告」問題、対策強化は大事やけど、単に指示待ちで終わらせたらあかん。自分の立ち場でできることを見極め、役割を果たす姿勢が信頼を築く鍵や。受け身と主体性のバランスを考え、地道な積み重ねを忘れんとこ。

items.title: 日本GLP／大阪市東住吉区で2.9万m2「Marq 大阪4」竣工、あらた専用で自動化導入の新拠点に
items.summary: 日本GLPは大阪市東住吉区に延床面積約2万8600平方メートルの物流施設「Marq 大阪4」を完成させた。この新拠点はあらた専用で、自動化技術を導入している。施設の竣工は10月28日で、物流機能の強化を目的としている。
items.commentary: 新拠点の自動化導入は効率追求や信頼構築の一歩や。隠し事なく透明に情報共有すれば、日々の積み重ねが信用となり、持続可能な関係が生まれる。焦らず誠実に進む姿勢が肝心やで。

items.title: ヤマト運輸／東京都江東区で12万m2の拠点稼働へ、仕分けとロジ統合で法人ビジネス強化
items.summary: ヤマト運輸は11月16日から、東京都江東区の大和ハウス工業開発の6階建て物流施設「DPL東京東雲」で新たな拠点を稼働させる。約12万平方メートルのスペースを活用し、仕分け業務と物流機能を統合した法人向けサービスの強化を図る。営業所も順次移転し、2024年4月には満床となり本格稼働を予定している。

karta.phrase: カイゼンは  みんなの宝

items.commentary: 大きな拠点の統合は、効率だけでなく現場の気づきが肝心や。日々の小さな改善が積もれば、組織全体の強さになる。焦らず仲間と共に、変化を受け止めて持続する商いを築きたいもんやな。

items.title: Africa’s ‘unprecedented’ Ebola outbreak could reach UK, says top health official
items.summary: アフリカCDCのジャン・カセヤ氏は、現在のエボラ出血熱の大規模な流行が英国など他国にも拡大する可能性があると指摘した。感染者は1万人に達し、死者は約5,000人に上っている。カセヤ氏は、この流行が新型コロナウイルスのように世界的に広がる恐れがあるため、感染対策や治療体制の強化に向けた資金確保が急務だと強調している。

karta.phrase: つまらない 話もコトも しなさんな

items.commentary: 感染拡大の恐れが叫ばれる中、無意味に焦るだけや表面的な情報に振り回されるのは避けたいもんや。大事なんは、的確な準備や対応策を日々積み重ね、信頼を築くことや。あきんどは、無駄な話に時間を費やすより、本質を見極めて動くことが求められるで。
